assumptions.statement: All geometry uses repository provisional rough boundary polygons. Official redline polygons have not been released.
assumptions.impact: Area metrics, land-use partition, and spatial relationships are approximate. Must recalculate all geometry-dependent metrics when official boundaries are available.
assumptions.recalc_trigger: Official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA GeoJSON files published in brief/site-package/geometry/

assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, building density, setback, and other regulatory controls are not available in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Conceptual building massing (44 buildings, 14.6 ha footprint) is a design quantity only, not a statutory control value. Height ranges in narrative are spatial form intentions.
assumptions.recalc_trigger: Approved regulatory planning conditions or official design brief attachments released.

assumptions.statement: Existing building inventory, ownership data, and current land use are not included in the public data package.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish classification cannot be determined. All buildings are labeled new_build as conceptual placeholders. Actual classification requires field survey and cadastral data.
assumptions.recalc_trigger: Existing building survey and cadastral data provided by organizer or professional team.

assumptions.statement: Road centerlines are agent-generated schematic alignments. Road widths are estimated by type (arterial 40m, secondary 25m, local 15m).
assumptions.impact: Road area (952k sqm) is approximate. Actual road alignments and redlines must follow official transportation planning.
assumptions.recalc_trigger: Official road network data or regulatory plan released.

assumptions.statement: Population, employment, and industry data used in narrative are from publicly available reports and news, not verified official statistics.
assumptions.impact: Public service facility sizing and talent housing targets are conceptual, not demand-based.
assumptions.recalc_trigger: Official census, economic census, or regulatory plan population data.

assumptions.statement: Rail transit references are based on publicly known metro lines. Exact station locations and future line alignments are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Transit-oriented design suggestions are directional only.
